description: Lesson catalog, navigation state, and persistent lesson storage using browser localStorage.

entities.name: Lesson
entities.description: A TOEIC lesson unit (e.g. Reading, Listening by topic)

attributes.name: section
attributes.description: TOEIC section this lesson belongs to

attributes.name: questionCount
attributes.description: Number of questions in the lesson

entities.name: LessonContent
entities.description: Detailed content of a lesson (persisted with lesson)

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Serialized lesson data (questions, explanations, media references)

use_cases.name: Load Lesson List
use_cases.description: User opens the app and sees the list of available lessons grouped by TOEIC section
flow: App loads lesson index from localStorage or bundled data
Display lessons organized by section (Reading, Listening, Grammar, Vocabulary)
Show lesson difficulty and estimated duration
Highlight user's previous progress where available

use_cases.name: Select and Load Lesson
use_cases.description: User selects a lesson to start or resume
flow: App retrieves lesson content from localStorage or bundled data
Load first unattempted question or resume from last position
Display lesson title, progress bar, and navigation controls

use_cases.name: Persist Lesson State
use_cases.description: As user progresses, lesson state is saved to localStorage
flow: After each question answered, update lesson progress
Store current position and user answers

data_persistence.lifecycle: Persist across sessions until cleared by user

assumptions: Lesson content is bundled with the app (no remote API)
localStorage is the sole persistence mechanism
